stories.title: 1Password launches a way for AI agents to log in on your behalf without seeing your password
stories.take: 1Password now lets AI agents log into your accounts without ever seeing the password — the credential problem for agents gets a real product answer.

stories.title: Canva releases its first image generation model
stories.take: Canva ships its own image model to all users, promising better, more customizable output at lower cost — design tools keep cutting out the middleman.

stories.title: Chinese hackers spied on thousands of companies after breaching IT giant ConnectWise
stories.take: Microsoft blames a China-aligned group for breaching ConnectWise and using AI agents to fan out into thousands of its customers — supply-chain hacking at agent speed.

stories.title: Meta shocked by $25B fine after N.M. refused to join multistate settlement
stories.take: A $25 billion fine — the largest Zuckerberg has ever faced — lands after New Mexico refused to join the multistate settlement. Meta says it will appeal.

stories.title: Microsoft’s Mustafa Suleyman says its AI outperforms doctors on hard cases as he chases ‘medical superintelligence’
stories.take: Microsoft's diagnostic AI beat generalist doctors on hard cases in a Science study, though most of the lift seems to come from the underlying models, not Microsoft's wrapper.

stories.title: Hackers got a four-day head start on epic PHP2Shell vulnerability
stories.take: Attackers were probing the PHP flaw four days before defenders were told it existed, and exploitation is now broad — patch first, ask questions later.

stories.title: Elon Musk made a $1 billion investment in Skydance, report says
stories.take: Musk reportedly put $1 billion into Skydance, a cash boost for the studio as it cuts costs and tries to lift its stock.

stories.title: Former OpenAI science lead launches Warp Science to automate wet labs with robots
stories.take: Warp Science wants robots running wet labs, trained by human chemists wearing cameras and sensor gloves — the lab-automation race adds another well-pedigreed entrant.

stories.title: Fusion startup Helion is developing new semiconductors that could double output of its power plants
stories.take: Helion raised another $225 million and is building custom semiconductors that could double its power plants' output, with a Microsoft electricity deadline in 2028.

stories.title: Samsung all but confirms iPhone Duo is goosing Galaxy Z8 sales
stories.take: Searches for Samsung foldables spiked right after the iPhone Duo unveiling — Apple's foldable is selling Galaxy phones too.

stories.title: Advertisers Pull Meta Ads That Had Unwanted AI Glow-ups
stories.take: Brands are yanking Meta ads its AI quietly 'improved' — and under new terms taking effect Oct. 30, advertisers are solely responsible for whatever the AI creates.

stories.title: Sociable: Meta adds users and revenue as AI costs climb
stories.take: Meta's Q3 revenue rose 26% to nearly $65 billion, but expenses jumped 68% on AI capex — the ad business is funding the buildout, for now.

stories.title: Dentsu Creative Expands Scope With Diageo Across U.S. Trade and Shopper Marketing
stories.take: Dentsu Creative widens its Diageo remit across U.S. trade and shopper marketing, extending a relationship that already spans 25 years.

stories.title: Why CNN International is building for agentic ad market that barely exists yet
stories.take: CNN International is building for an agentic ad market that barely exists, still chasing its first agent-sold dollar by Q1 — early, but the direction is clear.

stories.title: Why Reach Beats Creative: Angela Voss and Dale Harrison on the Marketing Math That Matters
stories.take: The marketing math that matters, per Voss and Harrison: reach more buyers, strengthen memory, and growth follows — creative is the multiplier, not the base.

stories.title: How Grocery Chain 99 Ranch Market Is Expanding Amid a Growth in Asian Cuisine
stories.take: 99 Ranch rides the Asian-cuisine boom with new stores and a cookbook, honoring its heritage while courting new shoppers.

stories.title: How CPG challenger brands are setting category marketing trends
stories.take: From Liquid Death's AI plays to Graza's packaging, challenger brands keep taking share from legacy rivals with far bigger budgets.

stories.title: Media buyers chart path for brands and sponsors through high NBA demand
stories.take: With NBA demand high, media buyers are weighing sponsorships against TV, streaming and social — the season tip-off is an ad market too.

stories.title: Rookie Lendeborg jaws at ‘weak ass’ Dončić and admits he didn’t watch much NBA
stories.take: Warriors rookie Yaxel Lendeborg jawed at Luka Dončić in his debut, said he lost respect for the Lakers star's foul-baiting — and admitted he barely watched the NBA growing up.

stories.title: Two steps too many: Refs confirm LaMelo traveled en route to 3-point make
stories.take: The refs' association confirmed LaMelo Ball traveled on the widely shared 3-pointer from Wednesday's win over Miami — two extra steps, no call.

stories.title: Trump criticizes LeBron for not standing still during national anthem
stories.take: Trump accused LeBron James of disrespecting the U.S. after the 76ers star kept warming up during the anthem — opening night politics, again.

stories.title: Warriors exploring trades for Kristaps Porziņģis, who is contemplating future amid health issues, per report
stories.take: Porziņģis is out indefinitely and contemplating his future amid health issues; the Warriors are still exploring trade options around him.

stories.title: NBA winners and losers: Giannis gets nothing from new Heat teammates; Steph Curry could be in for a long year
stories.take: Opening-night verdicts: Giannis got nothing from his new Heat teammates in a blowout loss, and Steph Curry could be in for a long year.

stories.title: NBA one-game overreactions: The Warriors need to trade Stephen Curry, Ja Morant is a perfect fit in Portland
stories.take: One game in, the grand conclusions are here: trade Steph, Ja Morant fits Portland — the annual overreaction tradition is alive and well.

stories.title: Around the World, Paris and 'giddiness': The dawn of the Ant-Melo era in Minnesota
stories.take: The LaMelo Ball–Anthony Edwards backcourt era opens in Minnesota with flash and renewed joy — 'giddiness' is the word around the Wolves.

stories.title: Jacob Misiorowski gets World Series Game 1 start for Brewers as he looks to reclaim his ace stuff
stories.take: Misiorowski gets the Game 1 ball for Milwaukee despite not finishing five innings in either playoff start — the Brewers are betting on the ace stuff showing up.

stories.title: Brewers vs. Rays just sixth World Series between No. 1 seeds in the Wild Card Era: How they've gone previously
stories.take: Brewers–Rays is just the sixth World Series between No. 1 seeds in the Wild Card era — sometimes the last survivors really are the best teams.

stories.title: The small-ball World Series? How the Brewers and Rays fit -- and don't fit -- the narrative
stories.take: Yes, it's two small-market teams that don't rely on homers — but dig deeper and the small-ball narrative only half fits this Fall Classic.

stories.title: Yankees, Cashman reach new contract; Steinbrenner puts blame on offense
stories.take: Cashman, in the job since 1998, gets a new deal while owner Hal Steinbrenner puts the blame for the early exit squarely on the offense.

stories.title: Uecker's family says he would be 'incredibly proud' of Brewers
stories.take: Bob Uecker's family says the Hall of Fame voice would be 'incredibly proud' of these Brewers as Milwaukee returns to the World Series.

stories.title: Brewers address $1,000 'Timeless Ticket' debacle as fans try to cash in for World Series
stories.take: Milwaukee's 2015 $1,000 'Timeless Ticket' — good for any future game — is suddenly a World Series golden ticket, and the team is sorting out the rush.

stories.title: 'Rays in seven, baby': Superfan Dick Vitale is ready for Tampa's World Series moment
stories.take: Dick Vitale, Tampa Bay superfan, will be in the stands for the Rays' home games and is calling it: 'Rays in seven, baby.'

stories.title: Russia bombards Kyiv with missiles hours after agreeing to resume talks with Ukraine
stories.take: Hours after agreeing to resume talks, Russia pounded Kyiv with ballistic missiles in an overnight barrage aimed at energy infrastructure before winter; Moscow claims 800+ Ukrainian drones downed.

stories.title: Judge orders Trump to sit for a deposition in his defamation lawsuit against the BBC by Dec. 11
stories.take: A judge ordered Trump to sit for a deposition by Dec. 11 in his own BBC defamation suit — and threatened dismissal unless he cooperates with discovery.

stories.title: Federal judge restricts DHS field operations looking for noncitizen voters
stories.take: A federal judge restricted DHS field operations hunting noncitizen voters, finding they likely violated the Voting Rights Act's bar on voter intimidation.

stories.title: Trump attacks Ohio governor over call for Ramaswamy to drop ‘deeply troubling’ ad
stories.take: Ohio's Republican Gov. DeWine called Ramaswamy's controversial ad 'deeply troubling' and wrong — Trump hit back within hours, splitting the state GOP weeks before the election.

stories.title: CDC denies approval for high-volume measles test, citing ‘other priorities’
stories.take: The CDC declined to approve a high-volume measles test, citing 'other priorities' — California, Oregon, Washington and Hawaii are asking it to reconsider as cases rise.

stories.title: WATCH: Blanche and Patel announce charges for Democratic Virginia lawmaker Lucas
stories.take: Virginia Sen. L. Louise Lucas, one of the state's most powerful Democrats, faces federal charges alleging she led a criminal marijuana enterprise.

stories.title: U.S. jobless claims fell to 194,000 last week, lowest since July
stories.take: Jobless claims fell to 194,000, the lowest since July — claims have stayed historically low all year, never topping 230,000 in a week.

stories.title: Christa Pike’s IV team warned vein might be ‘blowing’ before failed execution
stories.take: New accounts from Pike's lawyer say the Tennessee execution team doubted the IV line before the pentobarbital even flowed — the failed execution gets uglier.

stories.title: Dollar General agrees to nearly $1.9m settlement for overcharging New York customers
stories.take: Dollar General will pay nearly $1.9 million after New York inspections found overcharges as high as 39% on some items.

stories.title: Trump's political groups spend nearly $277 million in late midterm blitz on behalf of GOP candidates
stories.take: Trump's political groups have spent nearly $277 million boosting Republicans in the midterm stretch — an unprecedented sum for a sitting president.

stories.title: Feds allege $2 billion in California healthcare fraud, 15 charged
stories.take: Federal authorities charged 15 people, including six medical professionals, in California healthcare fraud schemes worth $2 billion — sham rehab programs and unnecessary tests included.

stories.title: Self-driving Tesla hits and kills 71-year-old pedestrian on California freeway
stories.take: A 71-year-old man walked into the path of a self-driving Tesla on Interstate 80 in Vallejo and died, the CHP says.

stories.title: Three rescued from rushing waters in the San Fernando Valley amid heavy rainfall
stories.take: Three people were rescued from the rushing Pacoima Wash in the San Fernando Valley as heavy rain soaked SoCal; a possible fourth victim was confirmed safe.

stories.title: Severe turbulence hits L.A.-bound flight from Hawaii, injuring 4 flight attendants
stories.take: Four flight attendants were injured when a United flight from Hawaii to L.A. hit severe turbulence Wednesday night.

stories.title: 5 more Orange County parents charged in e-motorcycle crackdown
stories.take: Five more Orange County parents face charges in the e-motorcycle crackdown — prosecutors are going after adults whose kids rode illegally on public streets.

stories.title: California mayor accused of stalking a hairdresser she thought was an ICE agent
stories.take: The mayor of Kerman, in the Central Valley, is accused of harassing a hairdresser she mistook for an ICE agent.

stories.title: New Medi-Cal limits force hard choices for seniors
stories.take: New Medi-Cal asset limits are forcing low-income seniors and people with disabilities to draw down savings just to keep their coverage.

stories.title: Meta strikes deal with Mark Zuckerberg to help him foot billionaire tax bill
stories.take: Zuckerberg agreed to stay in California for eight years — and Meta will help foot a possible one-off 5% wealth tax if voters pass it.

stories.title: Meta Falls After Boosting Spending Plans for AI Bet
stories.take: Meta fell after earnings: investors wanted a monetization timeline for its consumer agentic AI (Muse scaling 10M toward 100M–1B users) and instead got a bigger 2027 capex buildout with no number, plus likely equity issuance via non-voting shares • Unlike Amazon, Microsoft, Alphabet and Oracle — a combined ~$2T cloud backlog — Meta has no cloud business, so its AI bet has to pay off through consumer agents • Tesla segment: autos bounced, but holders care about robotaxi/AI, and the SpaceX merger talk (special committees formed, approval expected) is subsuming Tesla's narrative • Comcast lost more broadband subs than forecast yet rose ~4% on the World Cup boost and a newly profitable Peacock

stories.title: Industry Mourns BioWare - Kinda Funny Games Daily 10.22.26
stories.take: EA shuttered BioWare and laid off ~400; hosts and developers blame forced live-service pivots (Anthem) and corporate meddling for killing a legendary single-player RPG studio — 'You bought the pizza factory and made it make hot dogs' • CD Projekt Red credited BioWare for localizing Baldur's Gate in Poland and lending the Aurora Engine behind The Witcher 1; Warren Spector called the closure 'utter bullshit'; SWTOR's lead writer called its omission from BioWare's farewell 'heartbreaking' after 15+ years • A leaked canceled 'Mass Effect Universe' trailer surfaced (new Han Solo-style lead, Liara reveal); Amazon's Mass Effect TV series is still nominally in development, but hosts doubt it escapes development hell • Also: Capcom breach hit 11M+ accounts, Wolverine topped September sales, Dispatch hits 5M players with a Dec 9 mobile launch

stories.title: The rise of political slopaganda
stories.take: 'Slopaganda' is obviously fake, satirical AI political content — Spencer Pratt as Batman, Paxton ads with Talarico in an apron — built to reinforce narratives, not deceive, and it's running heavily Republican so far • Scale: ~$137M on AI-generated ads this cycle (likely an undercount) inside $11B+ total midterm spending, the most expensive ever; Musk has put $276M behind Republicans ($150M+ into Texas's Senate race), Bloomberg $80M for Democrats • Voters dislike AI ads even when disclosed, and labels can backfire on the creator more than the target • Experts' bigger worry is super PAC math: in NC and ME, Republicans outspent Democrats but got less airtime, since candidates get the lowest ad rates
